notes.title: Update 190718
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug that caused the software stuck at loading. 
2. Fixed the bug that caused the shades of the models of KumaKuma - Adventure Dungeon.

notes.title: Update 0625
notes.notes:
1. Spanish-Spain and Spanish-Latin America are now supported. 
2. Italian is now supported 

Thank you all for the support of our software, we are aware that it's far from perfect and we'll continue working on that. It'll support more features in the future, please stay tuned. Thank you!

notes.title: Update V0515
notes.notes:
1. Added auto-save feature: The software will now save to a new temporary project when unexpected quitting happens and a window will pop up to ask you if you want to open that project the next time you launch the software. 
2. Added in-app Workshop link to allow you to access it without internet limit. 
3. Redesigned the color of different directions in custom actions. 
4. Fixed the bug that caused unable to change emotions after aserting items from Workshop. 
5. Added 20 more items.

notes.title: Update V0506
notes.notes:
1. Added right click to insert 3D item, to let characters and items take the same place. 
2. Added 6 3D items and fixed the wrong position of a few items on the asix. 
3. Fixed copy action of 2 character layer that caused the disappearing of the 2 characters. 
4. Fixed the resetting bug when dragging an action to another box.

notes.title: Update V0423
notes.notes:
-Added quality selection in Edit, you can now choose quality with anti-aliasing. the size of pics imported and character limit in one page. 
-Optimized the boarder in dark pages.

notes.title: Update V0419
notes.notes:
1. The first function-oriented DLC, KumaKuma - Custome Pose Evolution, will be launched approximately next week.
2. Added a setting button near the layer part. You can access new DLC functions by clicking that button. 
3. You can now change the align of the words. 
4. Added 100 2D items. 
5. Fixed the the cache bug that cause function unavailable.

notes.title: Update V0416
notes.notes: -Cooperated with Vtuber Mochi, added Mochi model for everyone to use.

notes.title: Update V0325
notes.notes:
1. Opened up Workshop for 3rd party Mods and added uploading tools. (Chinese User Menu updated, the English is still under translation process.)
2. Solved the infinite loading problem when cancelling saving. 
3. Now the imported pictures won't get compressed. 
4. Added 2 new models. 
5. Solved the character shifting problem in customize action when pressing ctrl. 
6. Added decolor function to 3D scenes and 3D characters, the original decolor function is now renamed sketching. 
7. Solved the white screen problem that occurred to some people when saving. 
8. Added about 10 3D items and about 70 2D items and expressions.

notes.title: Update V0313
notes.notes:
1. Added 10 custom hairstyle for male. 
2. Fixed the bug that caused some of uou stuck at Loading 0%
3. Deleted some controversial clothing.
